title: From Harlem to Fort Dix: The Rise, the Reign, and the Reckoning of Sean "Diddy" Combs
author: Meechie's World Inc
blurb: From a little boy who lost his father in Harlem, to the top of the music business, to a federal prison in New Jersey. The full story, told straight, the way we tell stories on the block. 34 chapters, updated through October 2026, with about 600 sources.

title: Donald J. Trump: An Investigative Biography
author: Meechie's World Inc
blurb: Four indictments. Two impeachments. One felony conviction. And a comeback nobody saw coming. The paper trail of Donald J. Trump, from Queens to the second term, told from the public record.

title: Paper Trail: Jeffrey Epstein and the Fight for the Files
author: Meechie's World Inc
blurb: How the most protected man in America left a record he could not erase. Volume One, Part A: Front Matter and Chapters 1–5, from a Brooklyn boyhood to Leslie Wexner's right-hand man (1953–1996).
